vb_textbox.text: Start by picking a gnome. If the gnome is a high point earner (6-8 points) then keep selecting gnomes of that colour (pink/purple or brown/grey) until the points drop down to below 3. At that point switch to different colour gnomes (pink/purple or brown/grey appropriately). If these are high point earners (6-8 points) then keep selecting gnomes of that colour until the points drop down to below 3. If the colour change has not led to an increase in points, switch to selecting gnomes by their hat size. Please note that once the game starts you will lose points if you do not continue until the end. It takes about 20 minutes to complete. I earned just over 1000 points using the strategy above.
